scope: Native node/0 and compiler node instructions for unnamed non-distributed owned namespaces only.
adaptations: Native node_0 and node(Dst) return the current local node name. Replace ERTS singleton node/distribution entries with the owned code namespace's node_name, initialized to the native am_Noname (nonode@nohost). No naming, distribution, remote identities, nodes/0 or node/1 are admitted by this change.

The zero-argument BIF charges one work unit and reads actual owned state without allocation, interning, GC, leases or argument mutation. Complete compiler node_x/node_y cases retain native destination semantics and use the existing instruction work charge; only the singleton state access is replaced. Verifier admission explicitly recognizes node/0, not arbitrary bif0 calls.

Tests cover actual compiled and dynamic-apply calls, explicit X/Y assembly destinations, primitive zero/exact/extra work, every compiled work prefix, full-heap allocation/quota denial, source/heap-credit and namespace preservation, collection after return, live peer after reclamation and replacement, independent OTP observations and shared-worker exact/one-below/reuse/reclamation tests. No distributed-node or unique-node-name claim is made.
